To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the structure and function in neuro- and psychiatry are closely related.
the function of the nervous systems of patients with neurological disorders is profoundly influenced by psychological factors.

(1) the structure and function in the nervous systems of patients with functional disorders are abnormal; (2) these functional disorders are associated with a wide range of structural diseases of the nervous system; (3) the functional disorders in the nervous system of patients with functional neurological symptoms are complex and dynamic; and (4) the functional disorders are associated not only with psychological factors but with the social environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the structure and function in the nervous systems of patients with neurological and psychiatric disorders.
the structure and function in the nervous sytem and how these interact with the social, psychological and biological environment.
the structure and function in neurological and psychiatric disorders, and with the interaction between structure, function and psychodynamics in these diseases.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the structure and function in neurologists and psychiatrists are not as separate as they once were, and that they should be more closely integrated.

neurology is concerned with the study of structural disease of the brain and spinal cord and its effects on the function of the nervous systems, whereas psychiatry is concerned with the effects of dynamic disorders of function of the nervous and endocrine systems on the structure and function.
the function of the nervous sytem can only be understood by studying structure, but that structure cannot be understood in isolation from function.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the nervous system is a complex functional organ which can be affected in many different ways, both structurally and functionally, and which can be affected by many different factors, both organic and functional.
neurology and psychiatrists are not separate disciplines but complementary aspects of the study of the structure and function in the nervous systems.
the function of the nervous sytem is profoundly affected by psychosocial factors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the function of the nervous is profoundly affected by social and psychological factors.
there is no clear distinction between organic and functional diseases of the nervous system.
the brain is an integrated whole, and the function of any part of the brain is determined by its connections with other parts.
